REVENUE DELEGATION AUTHORITY ORDER NO. 0 1 6 2 0 2 6

In view of the approved personal leave of the undersigned from March 31, 2026 to
April 1, 2026, and in order not to disrupt the operation of this Bureau, as the exigencies of
the service so require, Deputy Commissioner LARRY M. BARCELO of the Legal Group is
hereby designated as Officer-In-Charge to perform the power and duties of the Commissioner
on all matters, except the following:

1. Signing of revenue travel assignment orders and revenue special orders for
reassignment of personnel;

2. Approval of original and promotional appointments; .

3. Approval of decisions on administrative cases involving dismissal of revenue officials
and employees from service;

4. All powers which cannot be delegated under Section 7 of the National Internal
Revenue Code of 1997, as amended.

This Order shall take effect on March 31, 2026 and shall be automatically revoked
upon the return of the undersigned for official duty.

CHARLITO MARTIN R. MENDOZ.
